title: Jahmyr Gibbs posts 'Sonic and Knuckles' tribute after David Montgomery trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jahmyr Gibbs posts 'Sonic and Knuckles' tribute after David Montgomery trade
sources.description: The David Montgomery trade will mark the end of the Lions' 'Sonic and Knuckles' backfield, as Jahmyr Gibbs lamented on social media.
